Domestic LPG connections to shift to commercial if e-KYC not done

Domestic LPG connections will be shifted to commercial category if customers do not complete their e-KYC process. This directive applies to users of Indane, Bharat Gas, and HP Gas. The e-KYC is a mandatory step for maintaining domestic gas connections. Failure to comply will result in the reclassification of the connection.
